name: Free Travel in Uttarakhand Transport Corporation Buses to Widowed Daughters-in-Law of Freedom Fighters
benefit: Under this scheme, widowed daughters-in-law of freedom fighters are entitled to free travel in Uttarakhand Transport Corporation (UTC) buses across the state.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a widowed daughter-in-law of a freedom fighter from Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must possess a valid identity card for the journey.
